question: The Chilahati-Haldibari rail link between India and ______ was reopened after a gap of 55 years in December 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chilahati-Haldibari rail link between India and Bangladesh **was reopened after a gap of 55 years in December 2020.
 
• A goods train was flagged off from the Chilahati station which entered India passing through the international border.
 
• The newly inaugurated **Haldibari-Chilahati rail link has become the fifth operational railway link** between the two countries.
 
• The Haldibari-Chilahati route will provide a transit connection to Bangladesh from Assam and West Bengal in India. 
 
• The other four rail lines between India and Bangladesh are:
 
 
• Petrapole (West Bengal, India)-Benapole (Bangladesh)
 
• Gede (West Bengal, India)-Darshana (Bangladesh)
 
• Singhabad (West Bengal, India)-Rohanpur (Bangladesh)
 
• Radhikapur (West Bengal, India)-Birol (Bangladesh)
